channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in South Africa
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: 5FM x Dial Direct: Spin the Wheel - share of R50,000 cash – 5FM / Dial Direct
item.description: Prize: Spin the wheel live on 5 Drive and win the cash amount it lands on, share of R50,000 across the week (doubled if you opt in for a Dial Direct quote). Deadline: October 30, 2026. Enter via the form on the 5FM competition page; selected entrants are called live on 5 Drive. Free; the Dial Direct quote opt-in is optional. Closes 30 October 2026. Residency requirements: see 5FM Ts&Cs (South Africa assumed)

item.title: 947 x Takealot Black November: Win a R5,000 Takealot voucher – Primedia / Takealot
item.description: Prize: R5,000 Takealot voucher per day if you guess the mystery product correctly on 947 (Johannesburg) (R6,000 for TakealotMORE subscribers), daily 26-30 October. Deadline: October 30, 2026. Needs your South African ID number: listen for the mystery product trailer (weekdays 15:00-19:00), then WhatsApp the keyword Takealot with your name and ID number to 061 4 947 947. One entry is picked each day and called live with Thando on 947 Drive; you win only if you guess the product. Free apart from data, no purchase. 18+ is not stated; no win on Primedia stations in the last 90 days. Runs 23-30 October 2026

item.title: Algoa FM x MTN (Eastern Cape only): Win up to R6,000 cash or MTN home internet – Algoa FM / MTN
item.description: Prize: R4,000 cash weekly via MTN MoMo (+R2,000 for MTN recharge of R50+), grand prize MTN Unlimited Home Internet for 12 months (R20,000). Deadline: October 30, 2026. Telegram or WhatsApp the word MTN plus your name, surname, town and story to 061 794 0940 (data rates apply) or use the form on the competition page; no purchase needed for the base prize. Only for people living in the Algoa FM broadcast area (Eastern Cape), 18+, winners must be South African citizens. Closes 30 October 2026

item.title: Kfm 94.5 x Takealot Black November: Win a R5,000 Takealot voucher – Primedia / Takealot
item.description: Prize: R5,000 Takealot voucher per day if you guess the mystery product correctly on Kfm 94.5 (Cape Town) (R6,000 for TakealotMORE subscribers), daily 26-30 October. Deadline: October 30, 2026. Needs your South African ID number: listen for the mystery product trailer (weekdays 15:00-19:00), then WhatsApp the keyword Takealot with your name and ID number to 082 945 0940. One entry is picked each day and called live with Carl Wastie on The Flash Drive on Kfm 94.5; you win only if you guess the product. Free apart from data, no purchase. 18+ is not stated; no win on Primedia stations in the last 90 days. Runs 23-30 October 2026

item.title: Penguin Random House SA: Win a Penguin Post 44 book hamper – Penguin Random House South Africa
item.description: Prize: A hamper of books from Penguin Post issue 44 worth R1,500. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Fill in the free online entry form (name, surname, email, province). South African residents 18+; no purchase needed; one entry per person. Closes 23:59 SAST on 31 October 2026. Newsletter sign-ups are optional

item.title: Penguin Random House SA: Win Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Fight or Flight plus a Lego voucher – Penguin Random House South Africa
item.description: Prize: The new Diary of a Wimpy Kid book Fight or Flight plus a Lego voucher worth R1,500 (for you and your bestie). Deadline: October 31, 2026. Fill in the free online entry form (one entry per person, no purchase). South African residents 18+. The competition page says entries close 4 December 2026, but the Ts&Cs say all entries must be received by 23:59 SAST on 31 October 2026, so the earlier date applies

item.title: STAEDTLER International Creative Challenge 2026: Around the World – STAEDTLER
item.description: Prize: Four prizes of a EUR 1,500 travel voucher + STAEDTLER product package worth EUR 500, plus a product-package prize. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Upload a clear top-down photo of your own hand-drawn artwork on the theme "Around the World" on the STAEDTLER page by 23:59 UTC on 31 October 2026 (free, AI images not accepted, jury and fan vote). Only for creatives aged 18+ permanently resident in the listed countries, including South Africa (organizer is German)

item.title: UFO Newsletter Subscriber Competition: R10,000 furniture voucher – United Furniture Outlets (UFO)
item.description: Prize: R10,000 UFO furniture voucher. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Subscribe to the UFO email newsletter via the form on the competition page (name, email, mobile, nearest store). No purchase. South African residents 18+ living in a province with a UFO store. Closes 31 October 2026

item.description: Prize: Tenba Axis v2 28L Spinner Backpack worth R10,295. Deadline: November 10, 2026. Closes 23:59 on 10 November 2026

item.title: Getaway: Win an overnight stay for two at The Marine, Hermanus – Getaway Magazine
item.description: Prize: One night for two in a Luxury Double Room with sea view incl. breakfast at The Marine, worth R15,000. Deadline: November 16, 2026. Fill in the free online form on getaway.co.za (name, email, phone, answer a question). Delivery within South Africa only. Closes 16 November 2026. Prize redeemable 1 October 2026 - 31 August 2027, excl. peak season

item.description: Prize: A Meerkat 50 chipper worth R17,825 (VAT incl.). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Closes 23:59 on 30 November 2026

item.title: AVBOB 10th Annual Poetry Competition – AVBOB
item.description: Prize: Cash prizes for winning poems (amounts not stated on the pages read). Deadline: November 30, 2026. item.title: Glowming: Win three nights in Cape Town for two – Glowming
item.description: Prize: 3 nights for two in a Cape Town apartment (The RandA Collection), a travel voucher and high tea for two at the Mount Nelson. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entries by joining the free Glowming Journey (2 entries) and a daily check-in on the Journey diary; buying pouches gives extra entries but is not required. Optional social posts also earn entries. South African residents 18+. Closes 23:59 on 30 November 2026

item.title: Jacaranda FM x Miway Friday Is MiDay: Win R1,000 cash – Miway / Jacaranda FM
item.description: Prize: R1,000 cash each Friday (R2,000 if you are a Miway policyholder). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Send a voice note on why Friday is your day to the WhatsApp number in the T&Cs (+27 84 850 0942); winners are chosen on Breakfast with Martin Bester. South African residents 18+. No policy needed for the R1,000. Runs 4 September to 30 November 2026

item.description: Prize: A brand-new 2026 Suzuki S-Presso car. Deadline: January 15, 2027. Download the free DocTalk ZA app, register and complete your profile for automatic entry (no purchase). South African citizens or permanent residents 18+ with valid ID. Closes 23:59 SAST on 15 January 2027

item.title: Algoa FM (Eastern Cape only): Care Like a Champion - win R3,000 in Pick n Pay vouchers – Algoa FM / Pick n Pay
item.description: Prize: R1,500 in Pick n Pay digital grocery vouchers for you plus R1,500 for the person or cause you nominate (weekly). Deadline: February 25, 2027. WhatsApp or Telegram the keyword CHAMPION plus your full name, town and a nomination (person, charity or community group, with their contact details and a short reason) to 061 794 0940 (data rates apply); a listener is called live each Thursday on the afternoon Drive show. Only for people living in the Algoa FM broadcast area (Eastern Cape), 18+, no Algoa FM win in the last 90 days. Runs 17 September 2026 to 25 February 2027

item.title: 947 x Spur: Win up to R2,000 in Spur vouchers – Primedia / Spur
item.description: Prize: R1,000 Spur voucher (R2,000 if you have the Spur app). Deadline: June 26, 2027. WhatsApp the word SPUR to 066 050 6830 and answer the birthday question (max 3 entries per day); winners are called on Saturdays on 947. South African citizens or permanent residents 18+. Runs 24 October 2026 to 26 June 2027

item.title: Woolworths MyDifference Play & Win (Black Friday edition) – Woolworths
item.description: Prize: Woolworths vouchers, cashback up to R50,000 (VIP up to R100,000) and product prizes such as air fryers, Nespresso machines or iPads. Deadline: November 27, 2026. Join MyDifference for free in the Woolworths app and play the weekly Play & Win game in the loyalty tab (once a week; link arrives by email each Monday). No purchase stated. Games run 2 November (00:01) to 27 November 2026 (23:59). Residency not stated (Woolworths South Africa)
